official_documentation_findings: Pact policies are fail-closed: an operation that does not match any policy when conditions is denied.
Within a policy, when fields are AND conditions.
message_sign controls EIP-712 typed-data signing and supports chain_in, primary_type_in, source_address_in, domain_match, and message_match.
domain_match and message_match use MatchRule objects with param_name paths, op values such as eq/neq/in/not_in, and value.
Path syntax supports dot notation for nested fields, [N] for zero-based array indexes, * for all array elements, and .length for arrays.
For EVM chains, CAW checks the request chain_id against EIP-712 domain.chainId and denies mismatches with eip712_domain_chain_id_mismatch.
notes: This evidence is scoped only to CAW message_sign typed-data policy verification.
No dashboard/runtime main logic, CAW payment, x402 execute, or gateway settlement claim is expanded by this run.
